content: However, the rapid evolution of the sector, driven by the global transition toward green energy and digital transformation, has introduced new imperatives for differentiation [15] . This transformation is heavily influencing South Africa’s consulting sector, as firms aim to meet elevating client expectations for innovation, safety, and operational efficiency [24] . Competitors that can seamlessly blend traditional geological and metallurgical consulting with cutting-edge digital transformation strategies are currently capturing the largest market share.
